title: Subadditivity of spectral sparsity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f$ and $g$ be real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb F_2$. The spectral sparsity of their sum is at most the sum of their spectral sparsities.
hypotheses_covered: arbitrary real-valued functions $f$ and $g$ on $\mathbb F_2^n$
